results.1: (LG) The Principled Patriot. "A king must honor the rights of his people." Believed rebellion was necessary but opposed the mistreatment of civilians.
results.2: (NG) The Reluctant Rebel. "I fought for my home, not my lord." Took up arms when royal troops entered his county. Never cared for secession before that.
results.3: (CG) The Commoner's Champion. "No man's blood makes him better than another." Despises hereditary privilege but also opposes the merchant oligarchs who led the rebellion.
results.4: (LN) The Loyal Retainer. "My oath was to my lord, and I kept it." Followed his noble house into rebellion despite privately doubting its cause.
results.5: (N) The Merchant's Son. "They meant to take everything we'd built." Fought because his family's business depended upon northern commercial privileges.
results.6: (CN) The Free Soldier. "Kings and lords can both go hang." Joined the rebellion to escape an oppressive life. Now refuses to submit to any authority.
results.7: (LE) The Merchant Magnate. "We built the north. Why should they rule it?" Financed secession to preserve profitable monopolies and increase his own political influence.
results.8: (NE) The Opportunistic Privateer. "A royal ship carries twice the plunder." Used patriotism to justify piracy and robbery during the war.
results.9: (CE) The Vengeful Partisan. "There are no innocent royalists." Blames the south for everything he's lost and sees atrocities as justified retaliation.
results.10: (LG) The Northern Loyalist. "The crown was wrong, but tearing Cador apart was worse." Opposed the royal decree but remained loyal to the kingdom.
results.11: (LN) The Royal Magistrate. "The law is not something we may discard when it displeases us." Believed the rebellion threatened the stability necessary to protect ordinary people.
results.12: (NG) The Peace Advocate. "A thousand graves for a handful of titles." Opposed the war from the beginning and sheltered deserters from both armies.
